product.olivetti-echos-20.summary: The compact Echos 20-series model with a monochrome display.
product.olivetti-echos-20.history: Computer Business Review documented the introduction of the compact monochrome and colour Echos 20 in January 1995. It listed this version at $1,640.
product.olivetti-echos-20.architecture: The local bus connected the graphics. The source lists VESA video, Fast IDE and a Type III PCMCIA slot.
product.olivetti-echos-20.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-echos-20.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-echos-20.press: Computer Business Review, 20 January 1995, Olivetti launches Echos 20 notebook.
